findings.text: the landing says '15 of them deterministic at the candidate' while artifacts.deterministic_added is 16 and the alone_counts show 16 ids at candidate_pass 0/candidate_fail 5; 15+4+1 does not sum to the 21 added ids, so the prose decomposition disagrees with the run's own counts.

the checkpoint says '125 pass, 80 fail' for the 210 alone-repeat runs, but artifacts record repeat_pass 125 / repeat_fail 85; 125+80=205, not the 210 runs stated, so the pass/fail counts are internally inconsistent.

the alone_counts verdicts label the 7 wheel-build ids and the 8 split_existing_runs ids 'deterministic regression at the candidate', a causal claim, while candidate_causes attributes the wheel-build failures to uv failing to resolve hatchling/hatch-vcs at a pyproject.toml byte-identical between the arms; the counts show fails-alone-at-candidate but not that the merge caused it.

the declared FENCE — SCOPE write path .../reports/reckon/the-crew-home-has-a-bound/cache-guard-whole-suite-at-merge is empty at review time and every artefact sits under the run directory outside that declared scope; the node discloses this in evidence_inputs.check_manifest_caveat, tracing it to the brief directing logs to the run directory, but the declared scope and the write location disagree.

item_verdicts.diff: the node authored no commit; git diff c5d4cc9a..5e58a9e9 shows the reviewed merge adds only tests/conftest.py (+155) and tests/test_no_test_resolves_the_real_cache.py (+61), and the reviewed node's own change is its scripts, logs and manifest under the run directory rather than any path under reckon/ or tests/.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names two per-arm logs with revision/host/command/reckon.__file__ headers and a pytest summary and EXIT=, the guard verdict at the candidate, and the added ids derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs and each run alone 5x per revision; both logs exist with those headers (gate-base.log:1-20, gate-candidate.log:1-20) and the manifest records the guard verdict, the empty named-test list, and the 210 alone runs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node was to run the whole tests/ suite at base c5d4cc9a and at the merge candidate 5e58a9e9 under the cache-root guard on two exclusive nodes; its manifest records both arms completing (gate-base.log, gate-candidate.log) and answers both briefed questions.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records per-arm summaries (base 33 failed/14135 passed, candidate 41 failed/12 errors/14115 passed), baseline_suite and after_suite with the reviewed revisions, failure_attribution for all 21 added ids, the guard verdict, and a disclosed scaffolding retry; its two prose count lines disagree with its own artifacts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence named only /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/the-crew-home-has-a-bound/cache-guard-whole-suite-at-merge, which is empty at review time; every artefact sits under the run directory, which the brief directed and the manifest's evidence_inputs.check_manifest_caveat discloses.

justifications.durability: The reviewed change is a measurement, not a guarded behaviour, so nothing regresses; its durability is that the record survives — the helper reproduces the count, but the logs (gate-base.log, gate-candidate.log) live only as untracked run artefacts rather than a committed or tested record.
justifications.evidence: Both gate logs carry the required headers (gate-base.log:1-20, gate-candidate.log:1-20, MODULE_UNDER_CHECKOUT=yes) and a summary; re-running reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the two log files reproduces the manifest's added count of 21 exactly.
justifications.fit: Artefact names (gate-base.sbatch, gate-candidate.log, repeat-added.sh, added-ids.txt) describe the mechanism and carry no plan, sprint, version or ticket identifier, matching the run-artefact idiom of reckon/crew.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The manifest (manifest.md:6, 16) records both arms completing on two exclusive all_debug nodes and answers both briefed questions — the candidate suite adds 21 ids (16 deterministic) and the guard is inert rather than clean — matching the node's goal of measuring the guard merge.
justifications.reuse: The node used the existing reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs helper (reckon/crew/review.py:2100) and the baseline_suite/after_suite/failure_attribution manifest schema rather than re-implementing added-failure derivation.
justifications.scope_discipline: The change contains no path under reckon/ or tests/ and every artefact is under the run directory, but the declared fence scope names only the reports path .../cache-guard-whole-suite-at-merge (empty at review time), so the write location and the declared scope disagree (manifest.md:26).
